name: Thunderbird 22.0
body:
New:
- Incognito Keyboard privacy setting disables Google keyboard from learning words (#3855)
- Thundermail interim screen when adding an account (#11102)


Changed:
- Selected sort option now shows an indicator in the sort menu (#11184)


Fixed:
- Messages could scroll horizontally when content fit the screen (#11038)
- Thread deletion confirmation incorrectly said only one message would be deleted (#8223)
- Notification actions were difficult to scroll and reorder on small screen (#11191)
- Show Headers collapsed multi-line email headers into a single line (#9452)
- Notification previews displayed HTML entities and markup instead of clean text (#8471, #10256)
- Select Image icon was hard to see in dark theme (#11202)
- Printed message headers always used US date format instead of local format (#11109)
- Splash screen truncated the Thunderbird name on small displays (#11172)


Contributors:
* Thanks to: @arpitagarwal1301, @coreycb, @dani-zilla, @frabera, @himu-gupta, @kryoseu, @mohitsatr, @mvanhorn, @rafaeltonholo, @saisafe, @shamim-emon, @stephenking314, @TusharBhatia34, @wmontwe

New Contributors:
* @mvanhorn made their first contribution in #11003
* @TusharBhatia34 made their first contribution in #11227
* @arpitagarwal1301 made their first contribution in #11280

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/compare/THUNDERBIRD_21_1...THUNDERBIRD_22_0

name: Thunderbird 21.0
body:
Changed:
- Animation setting now allows On, Off, and System Default options (#6027)
- Modernized 'Fetching mail' account settings screen (#11040)
- Modernized 'Composition defaults' screen (#10724)


Fixed:
- Application could crash due to memory exhaustion (#11153)
- Application could crash when rendering long messages (#11148)
- Inline images were shown as attachments instead of displaying in message (#10889)
- Server search results could disappear after loading (#9142)
- Manage Folders opened the wrong account instead of selected account (#11128)
- Android widget text scaled too large when system font size was increased (#7790)
- Cancelling the Thundermail OAuth process incorrectly redirects users to the "Redirecting to Thundermail" screen (#11043)
- Custom swipe actions were not restored from exported settings backups (#10621)
- Links failed when trailing punctuation was incorrectly included in URLs (#11060)


Contributors:
Thanks to: @coreycb, @dani-zilla, @frabera, @himu-gupta, @jim-daf, @kryoseu, @mohitsatr, @mvanhorn, @numericOverflow, @rafaeltonholo, @saisafe, @shamim-emon, @stephenking314, @TusharBhatia34, @untitaker, @varshilsoni, @wmontwe

New Contributors:
* @mvanhorn made their first contribution in #11003

* @numericOverflow made their first contribution in #11032
